description: List the team's tasks (the My Work list): title, type, status, priority, due date, assignees and the item, warehouse, order or partner each concerns, plus counts of open tasks by priority and unassigned. By default only open and in-progress tasks; status=completed|dismissed|all widens it. Filter by priority, assignedTo (an email or user id, unassigned, or me in the in-app assistant), item (id or SKU), warehouseId, taskType or a search over title and description; handoff=true lists the jobs users handed off to an AI assistant, each with its brief (work one with get_task, post the result with complete_handoff). Sorted by priority (or status, duedate, title, created); paged (page, pageSize up to 100). Open one with get_task; change it with update_task.

assignedTo.description: An email or user id, unassigned, or me (in-app assistant only).

handoff.description: Only hand-offs: jobs a user handed off to an AI assistant (task type handoff), each with its brief and subject.

item.description: Only tasks about this item (id or SKU).

priority.description: low, medium, high or critical (the effective priority).

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the title or description.

sortBy.description: priority (default), status, duedate, title or created.

status.description: active (default: open and in progress), open, in_progress, completed, dismissed or all.

taskType.description: Only this task type, e.g. reorder_alert, general.

name: list_tasks
title: List Tasks
